name: agent.claude
doc: Run a supervised interactive Claude session on a prompt in a working directory. Submit declared step outputs before the session ends; pass session to resume in the same directory. Runs Opus: model is a JSON object, by default {"type":"normal","model":"opus","effort":"high"}: {"type":"normal","model":M,"effort":E?} with M opus or claude-opus-5-5 and E low, medium, high, xhigh or max. The result's model names what ran (docs("plans"), Choosing a model).
